name: Haikei · Haikei

title.zh: Haikei · 在网页比较生成器

description.zh: 看实际低多边形图形与颜色、形状控件。 Haikei 是由 z creative labs GmbH 运营的网页端 SVG 素材生成工具，提供 Blob、Wave、Blurry Gradient 等多种生成器，可调节颜色、形状与画布并随机生成变体，导出为 SVG 与 PNG。Basic 版免费且免注册，Pro 版尚未发布，使用受其服务条款约束。
description.en: Haikei is a web SVG asset generator operated by z creative labs GmbH. Blob, Wave and other generators provide controls for colors, shapes and canvas, with SVG and PNG export. Basic is free without signup, while Pro is unreleased. Its Terms of Service govern use.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Haikei (https://haikei.app/).
Technology stack: svg.
Component specification: 看实际低多边形图形与颜色、形状控件。

Visual details from source observation: 我们从官网进入黑底编辑器，左栏比较斑点、波形、模糊渐变等生成器缩略图；当前画布是蓝色波形，另一状态展示三角网格，右栏可见颜色和形状控件。适合挑背景再调参数，SVG与PNG入口可见，本次没有下载或验导出文件。Basic免费免注册有官网依据，使用受自家Terms约束，不等于程序开源许可。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
